decisionsTitle: «Cine vine» says who is a Brașov Runners member: a declared tick or the members' account, a «BVR» mark beside a shown name, and «N vin · M membri» (amending §812 and §796)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19 16:50**, of the event page's «Confirmă prezența (opțional)» fold with the remembered browser's one tap and «Vin (2): … și încă 1»: «Și aici, la „Cine vine", trebuie să pot trece dacă sunt membru BVR.» And at 18:20, when the question was whether an Organizer or an Administrator is a member: «organizatorii și administratorii sunt peste membri.» The registrations have said who is a member since §796 (a declared tick, «Membru (declarat)», and an address that matches an account, «Membru (verificat)», §662); «Cine vine» said nothing. This gives «Vin!» the same two kinds, amending §812 and §796.

**Decision.**

1. **One column, two kinds, both stored.** `event_rsvps.club_member` (migration `0175_rsvp_club_member`, expand only): `DECLARED` — the person's own tick «Sunt membru al grupului …» on the page's form, in the remembered browser or on the link's page, a claim the club does not check — and `ACCOUNT` — an answer given from the members' zone by an account whose role is at least a member (`atLeast(role, "MEMBER")`, the zone's own door, `canOpenMembersZone`; so every staff role counts, the owner's «peste membri»). Null is «not said», never «not a member» (§650). **A text column with a CHECK**, as `asked_basis` is, not an enum: a third kind is a CHECK edit, where an enum value is an `ALTER TYPE` that a migration may not undo. Two booleans were refused: they allow the state «declared and account» twice over and say nothing about which one the club may rely on. The registrations derive «verified» at read time from the address (§662) because the address can match an account at any later moment; here the kind is **stored**, because it is read against the notice version the answer was given under (below) and an answer's «from an account» is a fact of the moment of the press, not of the address.

2. **The account's kind is made on the server from the role, never from a box.** `accountIdentity` carries the session's `role`; `answerRsvp` makes the answer `ACCOUNT` for any role at least a member and **ignores every tick** for an account; an identity that claims a tick as an account, or a role as a typed form, is inconsistent and refused (`isConsistent`). The zone's row has no box at all: it says «Membru» beside «Tu vii ✓» as a fact (BR-REQ-060-01). A page, remembered or link answer's tick is `DECLARED` — **«declarat» in the backoffice, never «verificat»** — and it is never read from anything but the one posted tick. An answer already counted keeps the stronger kind (`mergeClubMember`): a tick never lowers an account's mark, an account's press upgrades a tick, and a press that says nothing leaves what was said, as `show_name` does.

3. **Four doors, one tick.** «Sunt membru al grupului {club}» (the registration form's own words, `Registration.clubMemberDeclared`, the club from `CLUB_NAME`) is a real tick box, off by default, with the club's sentence for what «membru» means behind its «?» (`cachedMemberDefinition`, §789, else the platform's): on the page's form (posted as `clubMember`, read by `answerRsvpAction`); in the remembered browser's one-tap state, saved at once like the name's (`rsvpMemberAction`, and on the «Vin!» press itself); on the page of the «Nu mai vin» link, in the name's own form and the same press (`memberBox` says the box was drawn, so «unticked» and «not drawn» are never confused; the link is read, never spent, `setNameByLinkAction`); and on the email question's page beside the name's, taken only for the row the email made (`confirmRsvp`'s `clubMember`). The zone is the fourth door and has no tick. The service behind the three flips is `setRsvpClubMember`, `setRsvpShowName`'s twin (they share `lockOwnConfirmedRsvp`): ON records `DECLARED` and the notice in force and needs the event to take «Vin!» and that notice to describe the mark, OFF needs neither, an `ACCOUNT` row is not the tick's to change, and an `account` identity is refused (BR-REQ-060-01).

4. **«Cine vine» says it, and only beside a name that is shown.** `readPublicRsvps` returns, besides the names, `members` (every confirmed member answer, **named or not**) and `memberMarks` (parallel to `names`); both are present only when there is a member, so a page with no member is what it was. **A mark is the name's, never a row's of its own** (§143, §812): an answer that shows no name adds to «Dintre ei: M membri» and nothing else, and no mark can be beside «și încă N» because the read puts none there. Beside a shown member's name a small «BVR» chip (`GlyphChip`, the members' glyph, accessible name «Membru {club}»); the closed «Confirmă prezența (opțional)» fold's line says «N vin · M membri» and so does the facts' line («N vin · M membri · vezi cine»), in the house's three Romanian forms («1 membru», «2 membri», «20 de membri»). Nothing else in the name rule changes.

5. **The notice, and the §421 line.** The privacy notice says it in one sentence in section 4's «Vin!» paragraph and names the tick in section 5's list of what is kept: a person who ticked that they are a member, or answered from the members' zone, shows the mark beside the name they chose to show; the members are counted without names; the tick is the person's claim and the club does not check it; it is taken back where the name is; and the mark shows only for answers given or changed after the sentence took effect. **It is a marker of its own, `{{rsvpMember}}` („BVR”), not a sentence under `{{rsvp}}`**: every notice approved since §811 names `{{rsvp}}`, so words added under it would be «in force» the day this ships, in texts the club approved before they existed — the reason `{{rsvpAskAnswerers}}` is a marker (§823). `describesRsvpMember` is the gate (with `describesRsvp`, in every language): the form offers the tick, and `answerRsvp`, `confirmRsvp` and `setRsvpClubMember` keep a kind, **only while the notice in force names it** — a forged post under an older notice stores nothing, and an account's mark is not kept either. **How the version is recorded:** `privacy_notice_version` is the notice the person was last given — set when the answer is made and **set again when the tick is turned on** (`setRsvpClubMember`) or when a press moves the kind, as the name's tick does (§827); the public read counts and marks a row only if that version is that of the first notice that named the mark (`findFirstRsvpMemberNoticeVersion`, `publicRsvpMember`). An answer given before it is never marked and never counted among the members, whatever it holds; to be marked, its person ticks the box again (a person with an account takes the answer back and gives it again). **The same for an answer first given from the page or a remembered browser:** `ACCOUNT` is made only by `answerRsvp` from the account's own session, so a member whose answer is already counted does not get it from the zone's row, which offers no tick; they take the answer back and give it again from the zone (`SETUP.md` §46 says so). **The line is one-way, like the name's:** a row is read against «version at least that of the first notice naming the mark», so a later notice hand-edited to drop the marker would leave the earlier marks showing; the templates always carry it, and `describesRsvpMember` gates every new tick and mark. **The notice gives its basis:** the sentence says «Temei pentru semn» (consent, art. 6(1)(a): the member tick, or the name's tick for an answer given from an account) and where each tick is taken back — the recognised browser and the «Nu mai vin» link's page for the tick, the name's tick or the answer for an account's mark. `/admin/tasks` carries the row `rsvpMemberNotice` (open while an upcoming event takes «Vin!» and the notice is silent, done by itself); «Toate datele unei persoane» lists the kind (art. 15); a lawyer reads the sentence and the account's role sentence first (`SETUP.md` §46).

6. **The editor says what the club knows.** «Răspunsuri „Vin!”» shows, per row, the registrations' own chip (`MemberChip`, §662): «Membru (declarat)» for a tick, «Membru (verificat)» for an account's answer — the registrations' words, reused, where the brief's «Membru (cont)» would have been a third wording for the same fact — and the line says «M membri confirmați» after the counts («3 confirmate, 1 neconfirmate · 2 membri confirmați»: the members are a clause of their own, not a share of the comma list). The editor shows the kind whatever notice the answer was given under; what the public sees is rule 5's.

7. **A tick typed beside somebody else's address is told to its owner.** The page's form takes an address with no proof, so its tick is stored `DECLARED` for the row it makes (the name's way, §812), and the «Da, vin» email says what the press makes public — the name and, since this decision, **the mark** («cine a scris adresa a bifat că ești membru») — and the confirm page says the same sentence and **does not press itself** while it has a mark to publish, so the press is the owner's own, seen. The «Vii?» question's takeover of an unconfirmed row clears the member tick with the name and its tick (§812's «a stranger's typing is cleared»), and the question's page decides the tick in both directions: ticked gives `DECLARED`, unticked gives nothing.

8. **The link page reports each tick separately.** A press that changed only the member tick says nothing of the name (which never showed and did not change), as a press that changed only the name says nothing of the tick; a press that changed neither says the name's state, so «Salvează» is never silent.

**Refused.** A mark beside «și încă N», or any mark beside a name that is not shown. A member count or a mark read from an answer given under a notice that did not describe it. A sentence under `{{rsvp}}`. A member kind read from the form for an account, a role or a kind posted beside a tick. A tick for an account. «Verificat» for a tick. A toggle-glyph button (the owner, 2026-10-14). A second wording of the chip for the same fact. A kind derived from the address at read time (the registrations' way): a «Vin!» answer's «from an account» is the moment's, not the address's. Marking the answers given before the notice by the next press of «Vin!» alone (the person is asked, with the tick, under the notice that says it).
changelogLine: - **«Cine vine» shows who is a member** — «Sunt membru al grupului …» on «Vin!» (the page's form, the remembered browser, the link's page), a small «BVR» mark beside a name its owner chose to show, «N vin · M membri» on the fold's line and in the facts, «Membru» for an account in the members' zone (every staff role counts), the editor's «Membru (declarat/verificat)»; kept and shown only under a privacy notice that names the mark (`{{rsvpMember}}`). §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a «Vin!» answer given under a privacy notice that names the member mark (`{{rsvpMember}}`), when the person ticked «Sunt membru» or answered from the members' zone with an account whose role is at least a member, then «Cine vine» shows a «BVR» mark beside their name only if they also chose to show it, counts them in «N vin · M membri» whether or not a name shows, and never puts a mark beside «și încă N»; an answer given under a notice that did not name the mark is neither marked nor counted among the members (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a «Vin!» answer from the members' zone, when it is stored, then its member kind is `ACCOUNT` from the signed-in account's role on the server — for every role at least a member — and nothing posted (a tick, a kind, a role) can make it `DECLARED` or take the mark away; and given a tick on the page, the remembered browser or the link, it is stored as `DECLARED`, said «declarat» and never «verificat», and only while the notice in force names the mark (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Cine vine» shows which runners are Brașov Runners members — declared by them or from their members' account, beside the names they show
